_notes: Reference ranges for bottom-up and commander-first audits, measured 2026-10-29 from EDHREC average decks (regular and budget), MTGJSON Commander precons 2022-2026 and Scryfall type lines. Averages can include junk: treat a range as a sanity check, not a goal. A null range means no reference was found. Counts are nonland cards unless noted; lands counts the land slots.

vampire.source: precons (Blood Rites 35/35) + EDHREC Edgar, Strefan, Olivia

wizard.source: EDHREC Kaza, Adeliz, Azami (creature-heavy lists only)

insect.source: none: no Insect precon, and EDHREC Insect commanders run almost no Insects

knight.source: precon Cavalry Charge (32/32); EDHREC Knight commanders run few Knights

vehicles.source: EDHREC Greasefang, Depala, Kotori, Shorikai (regular and budget)

enchantments.source: EDHREC Eriette, Callaphe, Sythis, Tuvasa, Zur, Go-Shintai

artifacts.source: EDHREC Ragost, Breya, Urza, Sai, Padeem, Saheeli

sacrifice.source: EDHREC Kardur, Korvold, Prosper, Teysa, Yawgmoth

spellslinger.source: EDHREC Rielle, Veyran, Niv-Mizzet, Kalamax, Kess, Mizzix

lands.source: EDHREC Omnath, Lord Windgrace, Tatyova, Aesi, Titania, Moraug
